fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-05-12 at approximately 23:10, it was reported that the cousin of the complainant, Rakesh Krishnan, aged 21, left for a visit to relatives and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Vetri Nagar Shopping Complex in Madurai. The complaint was lodged by Venkat Kumar (9000000274), a family member of Rakesh Krishnan, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000381. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. A witness, Nithin Thangaraj, reachable on 9000000252, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, screenshot, witness, night, shopping complex
